title.en: Overleaf: deleted and renamed folders are cleared
title.zh: Overleaf：清除已删除和已重命名的文件夹

body.en: When a folder is deleted or renamed on Overleaf, sync no longer leaves the old folder behind on your Mac. Lattice clears only folders it has evidence for, and only files a build produced; your own files stay. Thanks to @nipunbatra for the report.
body.zh: 在 Overleaf 上删除或重命名文件夹后，同步不再在你的 Mac 上留下旧文件夹。Lattice 只清除有依据的文件夹，且只删除编译生成的文件；你自己的文件会保留。感谢 @nipunbatra 的反馈。

body.en: v0.16.14 shipped without an Intel build, so "Check for Updates..." on Intel Macs showed an error. This release carries Intel again.
body.zh: v0.16.14 发布时没有 Intel 版本，因此在 Intel Mac 上“检查更新...”会报错。本版本重新提供 Intel 版本。

fixes.en: The embedded AI agent is updated to Synara 1.5.1.
fixes.zh: 内置的 AI 助手已更新到 Synara 1.5.1。
